name: Sakurazatou
source:
The third year of university, spring break.
A girl wearing a kimono suddenly appears in front of Keisuke.
She asks him "Can you tell me three wishes of yours?" 

Even after all these years, this encounter is still etched in his mind.
translation: 大学三年级的春假，一个穿和服的女孩突然出现在圭介面前。她问：“可以告诉我你的三个愿望吗？”多年过去，这次相遇仍深深刻在他的记忆里。
